```{=typst}
#set page(
  margin: (x: 2.5cm, y: 2.3cm),
  numbering: "1",
  number-align: center + bottom
)
#set text(font: "New Computer Modern", size: 10.5pt, lang: "en")
#set par(leading: 0.72em, justify: true)

// ── Header ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#align(left)[
  #v(0.2cm)
  #text(size: 26pt, weight: "regular")[Aske Halling]
  #h(6pt)
  #text(size: 11pt, fill: luma(120), style: "italic")[PhD]
  #v(0.3cm)
  #text(size: 9.5pt, fill: luma(80))[
    #link("mailto:aske@ps.au.dk")[aske\@ps.au.dk]
    #h(1em)·#h(1em)
    #link("https://askehalling.com")[askehalling.com]
    #h(1em)·#h(1em)
    #link("https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=AyPnunoAAAAJ&hl=en")[scholar.google.com]
    #h(1em)·#h(1em)
    #emph[Updated August 2026]
  ]
]

#v(0.45cm)
#line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.8pt + luma(30))
#v(0.6cm)

// ── Section function ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#let section(title, body) = {
  text(size: 10pt, weight: "bold")[#smallcaps[#title]]
  v(0.1cm)
  line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.4pt + luma(160))
  v(0.35cm)
  body
  v(0.6cm)
}

// ── Entry: content left, year right ──────────────────────────────────────────
#let entry(body, year: none) = {
  if year != none {
    grid(
      columns: (1fr, 62pt),
      column-gutter: 10pt,
      body,
      align(right + top)[#text(size: 9.5pt, fill: luma(100))[#year]]
    )
  } else {
    body
  }
  v(0.28cm)
}

// ── Numbered publication ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#let pub(n, body) = {
  grid(
    columns: (22pt, 1fr),
    column-gutter: 6pt,
    align(top + right)[#text(size: 10.5pt)[#n.]],
    body
  )
  v(0.22cm)
}
```
